audit_member_text: L924-L929: DETTMP is first assigned the reciprocal determinant and then compared with 0.0. A singular denominator raises division-by-zero/Inf rather than making its reciprocal exactly zero, so the STOPP singular-transform guard is ineffective.
dispositions.rationale: DETTMP=1/det then compared ==0.0: reciprocal of singular det is Inf not 0, so STOPP guard is dead code
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: L1327 'DZC_Global(LG,:) = DZCK(K)' — IGRIDV==0 분기의 LG 루프(L1325-L1328) 안에서 K 가 루프 변수가 아님. 직전 K 루프는 L1299-L1301 (do K = 1,KC) 이므로 루프 종료 후 K=KC+1 잔존값으로 DZCK(KC+1) 를 참조하는 것으로 읽힘 — 의도는 DZCK(K) 벡터 복사 또는 K 루프 내부였을 것. 교차라인: L1299↔L1327.
audit_member_text: L1322-L1326: immediately before the IGRIDV==0 block, DO K=1,KC has completed. The block assigns DZC_Global(LG,:)=DZCK(K) instead of a vector/subscripted K loop, so K is the post-loop value (normally KC+1) and can be out of bounds while broadcasting one scalar across all layers.
dispositions.rationale: DZC_Global(LG,:)=DZCK(K) after DO K loop closed — K is post-loop KC+1, scalar broadcast/OOB
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: TOX 수층 초기화의 경계 시계열 존재 검사 인덱스 불일치 — 남측만 NCSERS(LL,4) @1948, 서/동/북측은 NCSERW/NCSERE/NCSERN(LL,5) @1959/@1970/@1981. DYE 는 4면 모두 (LL,3) @1834/@1845/@1856/@1867, SED 는 모두 (LL,6), SND 는 모두 (LL,7) 로 일관 — TOX 만 4↔5 혼재. 교차라인: L1948↔L1959.
audit_member_text: L1968-L1991: the south toxic boundary initialization tests NCSERS(LL,4), whereas west/east/north tests use toxic constituent index 5. This direction-only 4-versus-5 discrepancy is a likely copied suspended-load condition and can change whether south TOX values are imposed.
dispositions.rationale: south toxic boundary tests NCSERS(LL,4) while W/E/N use index 5
dispositions.decided_by: llm:claude-opus-4-8 (pilot; self-adjudicated, UNBLINDED — mechanics validation only)

base_member_text: L1031 read(1,66,...)C,(IFDCH(I,J),...) 에서 C 는 real 선언(@174)인데 FORMAT 66 'I3,2X,113I1' 의 첫 필드 I3 로 읽음 — 정수 편집서술자로 real 을 읽는 형태. 또 L1033 WRITE(7,166) 은 unit 7 을 명시적 open 없이 사용.
audit_member_text: L1031-L1033: foodchain matrix input reads the leading formatted integer into real C, but the diagnostic WRITE emits JDUMY, which is declared but is not assigned in this branch; the echoed row label is undefined/stale.
dispositions.rationale: foodchain read pulls leading integer into real C; B adds diagnostic WRITE of unassigned JDUMY

audit_member_text: L927/L1366/L1371 versus L3559-L3572: multiple calls pass STOPP('.',1), while the GNU preprocessor branch defines only STOPP(MSG). With no explicit interface this may rely on ABI tolerance for an extra actual argument; it is an interface mismatch even though the non-GNU IOPEN argument is optional.
dispositions.rationale: STOPP('.',1) calls vs GNU STOPP(MSG) — argument-count interface mismatch
